name: Forward Kinkspine
description: Raise the blade over the shoulder and drop the heavy belly onto the target in one downward chop.

name: Straight Slash
description: Lead with the heel of the edge and hack into the near shoulder of the target.

name: Planted Cho
description: Lift the spine into a falling strike and roll the wrist so the blow slides off.

name: Whumptrot
description: Pull the rear foot up behind the lead foot after a swing to reset the distance.

name: Gashwedge
description: Rap the butt of the handle against the opponent's forearm to shake loose their grip.

name: Kind Pommelcap
description: Hold the blade low with the belly forward and read the opponent's hips for the next move.

name: Hard Chopmass
description: Let the weighted tip swing down like a pendulum from a loose wrist and bite the target.

name: Level Gash
description: Roll the blade in a wide arc with a relaxed wrist so each cut gathers weight.

name: Snug Heavytip
description: Stop a blade that is swinging past the target with a firm grip and bring it back to guard.

name: Chipdodge
description: Slide the front foot under the weight of the swing so the body travels with the blade.

name: Waistdrop
description: Turn the edge inward and hook the belly behind an opponent's arm to pull their guard open.

name: Gashstay
description: Seize the opponent's blade wrist with the free hand while the kukri hangs ready at the hip.

name: Even Inwardcurve
description: Hold the blade steady at its balance point and feel how an opponent's pressure shifts along it.

name: Sharp Forwardbelly
description: Chop through the thick stems of a barrier in two alternating strokes to open a way.

name: Horntang Blow
description: Sweep the belly low and flat to cut the legs or stalks in front of the user.

name: Kinkspine Wedge
description: Knock a swinging branch or a thrown staff aside with a short flick of the blade.

name: Choamble
description: Move forward through growth in short steady steps while the blade clears the next pace.

name: Catching Whump
description: Hook a vine or cord with the belly and yank it taut across the opponent's stride.

name: Sharp Chip
description: Close all four fingers on the handle and chop straight down with the weight of the arm.

name: Straight Chip
description: Lay the thumb along the spine and cut a short tight arc that stays under control.

name: Descending Bulgeedge
description: Snap the wrist over to bring the belly back across the target on the return stroke.

name: Low Notch
description: Flip to a reverse grip and punch the point into a close target below the guard.

name: Raised Bulgeedge
description: Cross the wrist under the handle and turn the edge up to throw off a descending cut.

name: Gashdodge
description: Change grips mid-swing and turn on the ball of the foot to face a new line.

name: Locking Hookbelly
description: Slide the hand up to the guard end and jab the point into the opponent's wrist to spoil a hold.

name: Kinknote
description: Feel the blade's weight settle in the palm and learn from it when the grip has gone slack.

name: Low Lopstroke
description: Set the curve against the target and pull back so the edge bites and drags through.

name: Kinkdash
description: Hook the inward curve behind the knee and pull to buckle the leg.

name: Waistwedge
description: Cup an incoming blade in the curve of the belly and stop it dead against the guard.

name: Nabbing Notch
description: Pull an opponent's leading wrist across with the curve to break their balance.

name: Nimble Chopmass
description: Slip the front foot outside an attack while the curve hangs ready beside the hip.

name: Waistgauge
description: Judge from the feel of a light drag how deep the curve will bite into this target.

name: Downward Forwardbelly
description: Thread a thin line of qi into the belly as it falls so the chop lands harder.

name: Notchstrike
description: Warm the edge with a pulse of qi and return across the target with a short backcut.

name: Hookbelly Cowl
description: Flick the spine upward with a touch of qi to scatter a falling blow.

name: Slash Dodge
description: Ease the leg with a thin pulse of qi and draw the rear foot up swiftly after a swing.

name: Fouling Gash
description: Drive the handle butt into the forearm with a jolt of qi that numbs the hand.

name: Kinkhusk
description: Seat the belly on the opponent's wrist and pull so the weapon arm is drawn across the body.

name: Smooth Cho
description: Let qi rest along the edge and read through its faint hum how the opponent grips.

name: Level Pommelcap
description: Let the blade slide from the sheath already moving and cut across the target in the same pull.

name: Sudden Horntang
description: Lift the freshly drawn blade straight up and chop down with a pulse of qi in the edge.

name: Planted Heavytip
description: Raise the sheathed blade across the body to stop a strike and still keep the draw ready.

name: Notchamble
description: Turn the hip into the draw so the whole body steps through the opponent's guard line.

name: Watching Inwardcurve
description: Keep a loose hold on the handle and read when the opponent's eyes show a coming strike.

name: Single Lopstroke
description: Hew across the target at the waist with the whole weight of the shoulder behind the stroke.

name: Open Slash
description: Seat the notch on the target's haft or arm and shear the edge down against it.

name: Narrow Chip
description: Hack twice from opposite sides in a rhythm so the second chop lands as the target recoils.

name: Holding Inwardcurve
description: Catch an opposing edge in the notch and hold it fast before it can slide free.

name: Towing Gash
description: Twist the caught blade sharply in the notch to pull the weapon from the opponent's hand.

name: Backward Lopstroke
description: Step through behind a heavy swing and land beside the opponent rather than in front.

name: Kinkcowl
description: Press the notch down along a caught haft and hold it to the ground with steady leaning weight.

name: Chocount
description: Feel through the notch how hard the caught weapon is pushing and which way it will break.

name: Square Notch
description: Draw from the hip and slash up and across the target's centre before they can react.

name: Waistdash
description: Swing the drawn blade back under the opponent's elbow in a chop that follows the first slash.

name: Notchblow
description: Finish the draw sequence with an overhead chop that gathers qi on the rise.

name: Ready Chopmass
description: Bring the empty sheath hand across to knock aside a blow while the other hand draws.

name: Light Horntang
description: Slide the hip forward with the draw so the user arrives inside striking range in one motion.

name: Kind Heavytip
description: Keep the hand lightly on the handle and watch the opponent's belt line for the first lean.

name: Chohit
description: Time the chop to the end of the downswing so the weighted edge lands at full force.

name: Gnawing Whump
description: Bring the belly up from below along the opponent's centre line and cut as it rises.

name: Single Forwardbelly
description: Steady a long cross hew with a smooth stream of qi so the edge does not tilt off line.

name: Waiststay
description: Brace the spine with the off hand and take a heavy chop on the flat of the blade.

name: Sideways Hookbelly
description: Step off the line as the blade falls so the swing carries past while the body is already clear.

name: Towing Kinkspine
description: Snap the edge back up the instant it lands to jar the target's guard hand loose.

name: Pommelcap Note
description: Count the opponent's swing rhythm through the arc of the blade and find the gap between strokes.
